name: propose_mission
description: Draft the owner’s mission. JSON fields: key,title,goal,constraints with budgetMinor,currency INR,quantity,eventStart ISO with offset,timezone.

payload_json.description: Draft the owner’s mission. JSON fields: key,title,goal,constraints with budgetMinor,currency INR,quantity,eventStart ISO with offset,timezone. Encode the object as JSON; never include a token.

name: get_mission_brief
description: Read the owner’s current mission before discussing feasibility, revising constraints or starting work. Reuse it for greetings and identity questions. JSON object: {}.

payload_json.description: Read the owner’s current mission before discussing feasibility, revising constraints or starting work. Reuse it for greetings and identity questions. JSON object: {}. Encode the object as JSON; never include a token.

name: request_approval
description: Ask the owner to use an authenticated approval card. JSON fields: key,kind research or plan. This does not approve anything.

payload_json.description: Ask the owner to use an authenticated approval card. JSON fields: key,kind research or plan. This does not approve anything. Encode the object as JSON; never include a token.

name: update_mission_constraints
description: Revise only at the browser owner’s request. JSON fields: key,reason,constraints with budgetMinor,currency INR,quantity,eventStart ISO with offset,timezone.

payload_json.description: Revise only at the browser owner’s request. JSON fields: key,reason,constraints with budgetMinor,currency INR,quantity,eventStart ISO with offset,timezone. Encode the object as JSON; never include a token.

name: initiate_approved_work
